entities.name: Mula Mustafa Bašeskija
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mula Mustafa Bašeskija was a Bosnian chronicler, diarist, poet and calligrapher in the Ottoman Empire. He chronicled the history and events in Sarajevo, Bosnia, Herzegovina and in the Ottoman Empire during his lifetime and is considered an important figure in the history of Sarajevo for preserving information that would have otherwise been forgotten.
